name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold explorer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Salta province of Argentina. The project hosts Proven and Probable Mineral Reserves of approximately 124 Moz silver and 1.1 Moz gold. The company is advancing a Definitive Feasibility Study and received approval under Argentina's Large Investment program in early 2026.
